notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.
Two-manual Ecclesia default channels (from the previous T-270 generation): Great 1, Swell 2, Pedal 3, stops 12; CC11 expression 55-127, CC7 volume 40-127. Not verified for the T-255 itself.
Mixture and Cornet ranks are as printed (Cornet IV, Mixture IV, Scharf III, Pedal Mixture IV). Sample styles change the voicing but not the stop names.

MIDI scheme: The T-255/T-355/D-455 manual needs a dealer login; MIDI scheme from the Ecclesia T-270/T-370/D-470/D-570 user manual (July 2020), MIDI specifications p. 48: https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/39936-U2nl53k6kxTggXa022IJApZmpyGUyYdo1lp3IDjH1h5QZH7b6KbF2Wt9PTumaFIE-0/Ecclesia%20270-370-470-570%20Usermanual.pdf
